method_scope: training legal prefixes and existing fold coverage counts; no fitting, OOF, predictions or test reads
diagnostic_source_publication: Exact executable sources retained locally; public materials include hashes and detailed methods, not an independent full source replay claim

checks.schema: all88 training history CSVs concatenated, date/key/month uniqueness checked
checks.legal_data: only81 complete wells at each frozen cutoff enter input-quality statistics; raw full histories used for structure and construction of existing legal target panel
checks.missing: raw numeric coercion and finite/missing counts; latest and terminal missing runs separately counted
checks.windows: calendar span of last3/6/12 observed rows compared with row count; no reindexing
checks.duplicates: column pandas hash with equals verification, missing positions preserved; includes constants and two step columns; exact excess means sum(group_size-1)
checks.correlation: Spearman on81 distinct well histories, at least20 pairwise observations; abs>=.995; excludes identical pairs; no target correlation
checks.outliers: robust median/MAD threshold6 only as descriptive flag; no deletion or replacement
checks.folds: 30 frozen group folds examined manually for all-missing columns, validation-only missingness and unseen categories; no sklearn preprocessing fit
checks.scale: fallback determined from original last RCYL finite and positive, not scale==1
checks.supplement: observed pump domain flags and terminal missing co-occurrence; not score-dependent feature selection

limitations: No test feature distribution comparison or test-window parsing
No fitted model or OOF available in this diagnosis, so no error causation or platform gain assessment
Physical threshold flags need measurement/unit and business interpretation; percentage range is not automatic invalidity
Co-missing fields do not prove a common acquisition source or a missingness mechanism
Old historical loaded-dtype identity remains UNKNOWN; current frozen panel identity is independently matched, not backfilled
